detail.longDescription: 61% of developers who carefully review most or all agent-generated code still often approve at least one type of coding-agent action without close review. Incident awareness went the wrong way: 70% of those who knew of a security or privacy incident or concerning practice did this, vs 43% of those who knew of none. Most waved through: internet, API and tool access (36%). Survey of 203 devs, Wu et al. https:// arxiv.org/abs/2611.10058 # AIAgents # Cybersecurity # Programming
